item.title: Juvenile male in life-threatening condition after Fort Wayne shooting
item.description: A male juvenile is in life-threatening condition after a shooting on the 7500 block of Tanbark Lane in Fort Wayne Saturday.

item.title: Man dead after shooting on Indy’s east side
item.description: A person was shot on Indy's east side and is in critical condition.

item.title: Police-involved shooting on Indy’s eastside leaves 3 juveniles and 1 adult arrested
item.description: Three juveniles and one adult were injured in a police shooting in Indianapolis on Saturday night, after police attempted to stop the car they were in, believed to be involved in a recent shooting, and one of the occupants began shooting at officers.

item.title: Two 18-year-old suspects in Mississippi murder caught in Kokomo
item.description: Two 18-year-olds were arrested in Kokomo, Indiana on Sunday for first degree murder after an out-of-state call from police led to the suspects being located and taken into custody.

item.title: US Secret Service agents shot and killed armed man who entered secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago
item.description: An armed man was shot and killed by Secret Service agents and a Palm Beach County sheriff deputy after entering the secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, President Donald Trump's resort in Florida.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton away from Pacers after getting shingles
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Indiana Pacers guard Tyrese Haliburton will be away from the team for a little while. Haliburton, who is already out all of this season as he recovers from a torn Achilles, will likely be away from the team for the next two to three weeks after coming down with shingles. item.title: A few more cold flakes then a midweek thaw | Feb. 22, 2026
item.description: The area will experience a cold and cloudy week with light snow and flurries, followed by a warmup and precipitation, ending with drying conditions and spotty black ice.

item.title: Officer Brian Elliott honored at flag presentation ceremony in Beech Grove
item.description: Officer Brian Elliott was fatally shot while responding to a domestic call, and the suspect has pleaded not guilty to multiple charges, including murder.

item.title: Former Purdue wide receiver found dead in New Albany
item.description: Rondale Moore, former Purdue University football star and current Minnesota Vikings wide receiver, was found dead in New Albany, Ind. on Saturday, with police investigating the incident as a suspected self-inflicted gunshot wound.
